clauses.statement: Execute accepted replay commands against original emitted states, preserving identity-sensitive incremental replay, independent branches, exact states/events and ko rules.
clauses.test: Generate sequential, branching and ko cases. Compare full states/events with the original session owner; instrument Game.play to require six accepted commands to cause exactly six applications, while a JSON-clone control still replays its prefix.

clauses.statement: Reject game/configuration and reference mistakes without turning adapter failures into game outcomes or reusing another invocation's states.
clauses.test: Observe occupied/configuration refusals and recover from earlier successful states. Require missing, future and failed result references to reject outside captureError. Qualify simultaneous fresh invocations separately.

system.name: Weiqi incremental replay
system.description: Weiqi owns rule and immutable session state. The original Code adapter retains bounded references to observed successful source results; detached observations never replace cache-key identity.

concerns.statement: Execute accepted replay commands against original emitted states, preserving identity-sensitive incremental replay, independent branches, exact states/events and ko rules.
Reject game/configuration and reference mistakes without turning adapter failures into game outcomes or reusing another invocation's states.

viewpoints.name: Functional
viewpoints.method: Source-observed deterministic command history and game-boundary save projection

models.content: The Weiqi replay factory uses immutable original states as WeakMap cache keys. Code keeps raw successful result slots per invocation, resolves only bounded own data paths, validates current JSON without replacing identity, and emits separate detached snapshots.

decisions.statement: Extend the original factory receiver with explicit bounded argument-reference metadata; preserve the Weiqi API and session owner.
decisions.rationale: Cloning a state before passing it to extend loses incremental session identity even when the JSON is equal.
alternatives: Rewrite Weiqi into unary stateless wrappers and replay every historical move.

acceptanceObligations: Generate sequential, branching and ko cases. Compare full states/events with the original session owner; instrument Game.play to require six accepted commands to cause exactly six applications, while a JSON-clone control still replays its prefix.

Observe occupied/configuration refusals and recover from earlier successful states. Require missing, future and failed result references to reject outside captureError. Qualify simultaneous fresh invocations separately.
operations.behavior: Construct a fresh Weiqi engine and execute declared own methods. Explicit reference metadata binds null argument slots to prior successful raw states without cloning, while observations remain detached canonical JSON.
effectBoundaries: In-memory game only; no persistence, browser, network or cleanup protocol.
failureCases: Invalid references refuse outside source-error capture. Illegal moves and configuration mismatches retain the original game errors. Capturing a source error does not imply rollback.
postconditions: Accepted commands use the original incremental session state. Older successful states remain valid independent branch points. Observation snapshots do not change after later calls.
preconditions: Only earlier successful nonvoid results in this invocation may be referenced. Paths address existing own enumerable data properties and cannot traverse getters, proxies or prototypes.
resourceBounds: At most 16 calls, 2 arguments per call and one path component. Original JSON request/observation bounds apply.

testObligations.behavior: Construct a fresh Weiqi engine and execute declared own methods. Explicit reference metadata binds null argument slots to prior successful raw states without cloning, while observations remain detached canonical JSON.
preconditions: Only earlier successful nonvoid results in this invocation may be referenced. Paths address existing own enumerable data properties and cannot traverse getters, proxies or prototypes.
postconditions: Accepted commands use the original incremental session state. Older successful states remain valid independent branch points. Observation snapshots do not change after later calls.
failureCases: Invalid references refuse outside source-error capture. Illegal moves and configuration mismatches retain the original game errors. Capturing a source error does not imply rollback.
resourceBounds: At most 16 calls, 2 arguments per call and one path component. Original JSON request/observation bounds apply.
effectBoundaries: In-memory game only; no persistence, browser, network or cleanup protocol.
acceptance: Generate sequential, branching and ko cases. Compare full states/events with the original session owner; instrument Game.play to require six accepted commands to cause exactly six applications, while a JSON-clone control still replays its prefix.

Observe occupied/configuration refusals and recover from earlier successful states. Require missing, future and failed result references to reject outside captureError. Qualify simultaneous fresh invocations separately.

Observe occupied/configuration refusals and recover from earlier successful states. Require missing, future and failed result references to reject outside captureError. Qualify simultaneous fresh invocations separately.
